text: Gotcha (from the DAS Bingo engineer): apps/web/src/arcade/arcade.css defines a global `.room { position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:-1; pointer-events:none }` that collides with the shell's `.room` wrapper in shell/RoomScreen.tsx, so every lobby/game room becomes unclickable (e.g. 'Start game' is intercepted by #root). The arcade room class needs a unique prefix.

DASCADE expansion (2026-09-26): 16 Opus build agents run in parallel on ports 2601-2616 (server) / 5201-5216 (web); the owner's dev server is on 2580/5180 in terminal Baylee and must not be killed; contract at .scratch/EXPANSION/CONTRACT.md.

DAS-Games-1 expansion 14:40: disk /System/Volumes/Data hit 100% (ENOSPC, ~150MB free) because swap is nearly exhausted (18.3/19.2GB used) — agents should stop idle dev servers/browsers and avoid builds; masterpiece agent has stopped its own :2610/:5210 servers.

DASCADE expansion gotcha (tanks agent): with ~16 Vite/tsx dev servers running, file watchers silently miss edits (no HMR, stale modules served) — restart your own Vite/game-server by PID after edits before trusting screenshots or E2E results.
